answer: Because the ember salt is published after the vine checkpoint, the timber audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 188 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 162 keys hence burns for 162 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
